chunks: And with his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Indeed, Fatima preserved her chastity, so God forbade the Fire from touching her progeny.

key_terms.فَاطِمَ: Fatima, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Fatima's chastity regarding her progeny's entry into Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the Shia doctrine of *Taharah* (purity) extending to the Ahl al-Bayt, linking Lady Fatima’s preservation of chastity (*Ihsan*) to the divine guarantee of her progeny’s salvation. It serves as a foundational text for the belief that the spiritual merit of the Imams, descending from Fatima, ensures their protection from the Hellfire, a concept deeply rooted in both hadith and Quranic exegesis.
